SELECT t.code AS term_code, t.name AS term_name, t.sequence, r.attempted_credits, r.earned_credits, r.gpa_credits, r.term_gpa, r.cumulative_attempted, r.cumulative_earned, r.cumulative_gpa, r.standing, r.classification FROM student_term_record r JOIN academic_term t ON t.id = r.term_id WHERE r.student_id = 813 ORDER BY t.sequence
